review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR and CS_ENGINE_IMAGE set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second record, lifetime-end.json, holding the engine image digest, the resolutions and the limitations. MEASURED by static analysis of the owner-supplied decrypted executable (byte windows and closed caller inventories pinned in the acceptance test): at the end of RANGE (record +0x1c, default 500.0 at 0x5ad80b when the key is absent) the step either detonates (0x5ac3a0) or removes the node silently by setting its state to 0 at 0x5b0318; the cleanup walk 0x5af900 releases a state-0 node one frame later through 0x5b08d0; a session teardown (0x5ae810/0x5ae950 -> 0x5ae820 -> 0x5ae690(0)) destroys the visuals of every pool node and frees the pool and the weapon table without calling any projectile callback; CLUSTER_SIZE (descriptor +0x0c) is read only by the getter 0x4bad90 (two callers) and a byte test at 0x4ab16b, never by the launch routine 0x5aef40. STILL UNMEASURED (none claimed): see the limitations array of lifetime-end.json. The claim is implemented: this awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
